description: Read native expedition account state, selected-character Bottle bonus, Fractal flags, and initialized Shimmer shop costs without entering island scenes
target: Island Expeditions account state and numeric outcomes

extractions.label: island_state
extractions.description: Current account balances and activity state. Native Bottle bonus belongs to the active character. Native Fractal helper reads initialized unlock flags. Existing shovel, kitchen and talent contributions convert flags 4, 2 and 5 to 25, 30 and 100 respectively, as established by native source and retained domain behavior.

extractions.label: shimmer_shop_cache
extractions.description: Read the original initialized Shimmer shop cache. Tests require matching trial and base allocations; no scene event is called to populate or refresh this cache.
